description: This file contains the main client-side logic for a WebRTC-based remote device control interface, including UI setup, device connection management, display handling, sensor injection, and command processing.

classes.name: DeviceDetailsUpdater
classes.description: A class to update device hardware and state details in the UI.

classes.name: EmptyDeviceDisplaysMessage
classes.description: A placeholder class for device display messages when no real implementation is available.

classes.name: EmptyParentController
classes.description: A placeholder class for parent controller when none is provided.

classes.name: DeviceControlApp
classes.description: Main class managing device control UI, connection, and interactions.

methods.name: ConnectDevice
methods.description: Asynchronously connects to a device using the provided device ID and server connector.

methods.name: showMessage
methods.description: Displays a message in the error message UI element with styling and optional duration.
